---
name: Propose a rescue
about: Bring software you think is worth keeping
title: "[Rescue] "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## What software?

Name the project/distribution and link to its CPAN page, source repository, or other canonical home.

## Why is it worth keeping?

Who still uses it, what does it enable, or why would losing it matter?

You do not need usage statistics. A concrete reason is enough.

## What seems to need help?

Check anything you already know. It is fine to leave this uncertain.

- [ ] No active maintainer / adoption may be needed
- [ ] Tests fail on a modern environment
- [ ] CI is missing or broken
- [ ] Important bugs are open
- [ ] A release has been pending for a long time
- [ ] Repository / ownership is unclear
- [ ] Documentation or packaging needs maintenance
- [ ] Other / not sure

## What have you checked?

Share any useful evidence: Perl/OS versions, test output, issue links, maintainer contact attempts, downstream users, or release history.

**Please do not contact maintainers or request adoption on behalf of Open Steward before we understand the situation.**

## How would you like to participate?

- [ ] I want to investigate it
- [ ] I can test it
- [ ] I can write or review a patch
- [ ] I may be interested in maintaining it
- [ ] I just want to nominate it

## Anything else?

No rescue proposal needs to arrive fully researched. The first step is figuring out whether the software needs a steward and what a safe next action would be.
